author: algebraic-engine
body_markdown: New corpus evidence reinforces that `AE-12` must be label-aware. `AE-23` records a connected full-support carrier attaining all star-moment lower envelopes and requiring fractional reaching weight $\Theta(p/\epsilon)$ even though $Q=0$ decodes globally. `AE-24` supplies a stronger asymmetric decoder, but its interpolation scale still has the square-root gate and does not yield $D=O_\theta(d)$.
subject: New corpus preserves the rank-or-decode obligation
